method: mono mix; FFT cross-correlation over lags of +/-4000 samples in four 10 s windows (1-11, 60-70, 125-135, 185-195 s), parabolic sub-sample peak; residualDb is the aligned difference energy relative to the reference (lossy codecs leave -20 to -30 dB of waveform difference, which is not a timing error). A positive lag means the file plays later than the map.
